description: This is the main activity class for an Android wearable application that interacts with Google Play services and the Wearable Data Layer API. It handles connection setup, data item management, message passing, capability changes, and user interactions such as taking and sending photos to a paired wearable device.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing wearable data interactions, user interface, and camera features.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Helper class representing log events for display in the UI list.

classes.name: DataItemAdapter
classes.description: Custom ArrayAdapter to display Event objects in a list view.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, and connects the GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects GoogleApiClient when activity starts.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Schedules periodic data item generation.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Cancels data item generation when activity pauses.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Removes listeners and disconnects GoogleApiClient when activity stops.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from camera intent, retrieves thumbnail image.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient connection is established; registers listeners.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback when the connection is suspended.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles connection failures, attempts resolution.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles data change events from the Data Layer.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages from the wearable.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Handles capability change events.

methods.name: setupViews
methods.description: Initializes UI components and their event handlers.

methods.name: onTakePhotoClick
methods.description: Triggers camera intent for taking a photo.

methods.name: onSendPhotoClick
methods.description: Sends the captured photo as an asset to the wearable.

methods.name: onStartWearableActivityClick
methods.description: Sends a message to start an activity on the wearable.

methods.name: sendStartActivityMessage
methods.description: Sends a start activity message to a specific node.

methods.name: dispatchTakePictureIntent
methods.description: Starts camera activity to take a picture.

methods.name: toAsset
methods.description: Converts a Bitmap to a Wearable Asset.

methods.name: sendPhoto
methods.description: Sends the photo asset as a DataItem to the data layer.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Retrieves connected wearable nodes.

methods.name: LOGD
methods.description: Utility for logging debug messages.

methods.name: DataItemGenerator
methods.description: Runnable class that periodically generates and sends count DataItems.
